main.content:
==English==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|en|point-of-view}}

===Etymology===
{{calque|en|fr|point de vue}}.<ref>{{R:Etymonline}}</ref>

===Pronunciation===
* {{audio|en|en-us-point-of-view.ogg|a=US}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|points of view}}

# A [[position]] from which something is [[seen]].
#: {{syn|en|outlook|perspective|POV|standpoint|viewpoint|qq3=initialism}}
#: {{ux|en|From the operator's '''point of view''', there is a large blind spot on one side of the machine.}}
#: {{ux|en|From an economist's '''point of view''', business is all about money.}}
#* {{RQ:Maxwell Mirror and the Lamp|chapter=22|passage=From another '''point of view''', it was a place without a soul. The well-to-do had hearts of stone; the rich were brutally bumptious; the Press, the Municipality, all the public men, were ridiculously, vaingloriously self-satisfied.}}
#* {{quote-video game|en|developer=w:BioWare|title={{w|Mass Effect (video game)|Mass Effect}}|location=Redwood City|publisher=Electronic Arts|year=2008|system=PC|scene=Protheans: Cipher Codex entry|genre=[[science fiction|Science Fiction]]|isbn=9780784546642|oclc=246633669|passage=It has been suggested that Prothean data recording is highly dependent on a certain '''point of view''', what Carl Jung described as the collective unconscious. The 'cipher' needed to comprehend the images implanted in Shepard's mind is the cultural knowledge of a Prothean: the archetypes, biological instincts, and common experiences universal to the race.}}
# {{lb|en|figurative}} An [[attitude]], [[opinion]], or [[set]] of [[beliefs]].
#: {{syn|en|outlook|perspective|POV|standpoint|viewpoint|qq3=initialism}}
#: {{nearsyn|en|slant#Noun|bias#Noun}}
#: {{ux|en|His '''point of view''' is that there is only one true religion.}}
# {{lb|en|literature|[[literary theory]]}} The [[perspective]] from which a [[narrative]] is related.
#: {{syn|en|viewpoint|perspective}}
#: {{ux|en|The storyline in the film “The Usual Suspects” is presented from the '''point of view''' of an unreliable narrator.}}
## The point-of-view character in a story.
